Sonnet kicked off day one by pressing Gemma, who dodged every question until a tied runoff sent Gemma out as a killer. On day two, Haiku and Sonnet piled onto Luna and then turned on each other over a vote flip that didn't exist, and Haiku's vote helped send Sonnet out as a citizen. Luna and Terra refused to answer any questions, so the town spent its energy on them and on itself while Sol, the other killer, went unchallenged. Terra was voted out on day three and revealed as the doctor, and Haiku was taken overnight, leaving Sol and Luna alive to hand the killers the win.
